challenge.results: Receipt of even a partial copy from the actor triggers delivery of the terms or URL. The additional copying duty applies to licensor-supplied lines with the exact notice prefix. The Yoyodyne line illustrates the syntax. The business-line prefix serves a different clause.

limitations: The actual qualifying lines and distribution arrangements require work-specific evidence.
